headline: Lindblad drops five places, Colapinto ten and Bortoleto starts at the back
body: Power unit changes give Lindblad a five-place grid penalty and Colapinto a ten-place drop for the United States Grand Prix. Bortoleto's energy store and control electronics changes bring a cumulative 20-place penalty, requiring a back-of-grid start. The penalties change Sunday's starting grid; qualifying classification is unchanged.

headline: Leclerc leads Austin FP1 by 0.084s from Verstappen
body: Leclerc set a 1:36.052 in Ferrari's upgraded car, ahead of Verstappen and Norris, with Russell and Antonelli fourth and fifth. Verstappen had a faster lap deleted for track limits at Turn 19. Williams spent much of the session on data collection runs before Sainz and Albon attempted timed laps.
